snippet.title: Adventures of Ruby Rabbit // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205570/Adventures_of_Ruby_Rabbit

"The Adventure of Ruby Rabbit" is a light action shooter adventure game. In the game, you can control Ruby the cute bunny, fight the bunny balls, and grow as she grows.

Developed by
LFCat Studio
